$comment: P4.D275 tier-2 spec for v4's `listAllPhotoAlbumOptions` (`lib/photos/photo-album-options.ts`, `01a83539d`) — the wardrobe picture viewer's every-store save-target list. Base: the item-images tier-2 builder's pair (`build-wardrobe-item-images-fixture.ts`), built into this family's OWN paths. Per case both sides run the same `main` / `mount` SQL plants on a FRESH copy (stores planted `INSERT … SELECT` from General's row with overrides, so every NOT NULL column and v4's Zod see a valid row; every planted name is NOCASE-distinct — P4.D275 R-L), then ONE `listAllPhotoAlbumOptions` call. Compared: the `{albums}` bytes (key order included) and the ordered log lines of the call (v4's backend `Raw query failed` dropped by the standing convention).

Base fixture: General (rowid 4), Abigail's live LLM vault (rowid 1), the ARCHIVED Bartholomew's vault (rowid 2, skipped), the stranger's live vault (rowid 3 — v4 does not filter by owner), the project's official store (rowid 5) and the group's (rowid 6 — a plain document-store).
